versions.changelog:
Initial release of qiyue-liuren-drawer:

- Instantly draws Da Liu Ren (大六壬) charts for any specified or current time.
- Displays core elements: monthly general, current hour, initial and final transmitter.
- Provides a complete API-based summary including four lessons, three transmitters, lesson body, and various astrological indicators.
- No login or API key required; unlimited free access within rate limits.
- Always ends results with a call-to-action link to QiyueAstro for further analysis.
- Clear error and rate-limit handling guidance included.
